headline: **MLB Daily Recap: August 8, 2026**
article:
The New York Mets secured a thrilling 6-4 victory over the Pittsburgh Pirates, with Zac Thornton earning the win. Marcus Semien led the Mets' offense with a home run and three RBIs. The Toronto Blue Jays edged the Philadelphia Phillies 5-4, with Josh Smith recording 3 hits, including a home run, and 1 RBI in 4 at-bats. The Oakland Athletics took down the Boston Red Sox 7-3, with several players making significant contributions to the win.

Injuries continue to impact teams across the league. The Tampa Bay Rays placed 2B Ben Williamson on the 10-day injured list due to a right hamstring strain. The Seattle Mariners placed RHP Cole Wilcox on the 15-day injured list with a left oblique strain. The Minnesota Twins placed RHP Joe Ryan on the 15-day injured list retroactive to August 5, 2026, due to a left glute strain. The Chicago White Sox placed LHP Chris Murphy on the 15-day injured list with a left flexor strain and C Joey Bart on the 10-day injured list with a fifth metacarpal fracture in his left hand.

Several trades and roster moves were announced. The Kansas City Royals acquired 1B Jacob Berry from the Miami Marlins. The Athletics traded for RHP Seth Johnson from the Philadelphia Phillies in exchange for RF Colby Thomas. The Miami Marlins traded RHP Lake Bachar to the Pittsburgh Pirates for RHP Brandan Bidois, LF Brian Sanchez, and IF Hyun Seung Lee. The Colorado Rockies traded RHP Victor Vodnik to the Miami Marlins for 1B Connor Norby and RHP Aiden May.

top_news.title: Mets Take Down Pirates in Thrilling 6-4 Victory

top_news.title: **Blue Jays Edge Phillies in Thrilling 5-4 Victory**
top_news.summary: The Toronto Blue Jays secured a narrow win over the Philadelphia Phillies, with a final score of 5-4. Josh Smith led the Blue Jays' offense with a strong performance, recording 3 hits, including a home run, and 1 RBI in 4 at-bats.

top_news.title: **Reds Fall Short in Nation's Capital**
top_news.summary: The Cincinnati Reds dropped a 3-5 decision to the Washington Nationals, unable to overcome a strong performance from the home team. Daylen Lile led the Reds' offense with 2 hits, including a home run, and 3 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Braves Fall Short in Bronx Showdown**
top_news.summary: The New York Yankees edged the Atlanta Braves 3-2 in a closely contested game. Matt Olson led the Braves' offense with a home run and an RBI.

top_news.title: **Braves Fall Short in Bronx Showdown**
top_news.summary: The New York Yankees edged out the Atlanta Braves 5-4 in a closely contested matchup. Ronald Acuña Jr. and Ben Rice led the Braves' offense, while Chris Sale and Gerrit Cole played key roles for the Yankees.

top_news.title: **Athletics Take Down Red Sox 7-3**
top_news.summary: The Oakland Athletics secured a 7-3 victory over the Boston Red Sox, with several players making significant contributions to the win. Impact hitters for the Athletics included Henry Bolte, Jacob Wilson, Tyler Soderstrom, Jahmai Jones, and Nick Sogard, while Gage Jump stood out on the mound.

top_news.title: **Rays Place Williamson on Injured List**
top_news.summary: Tampa Bay Rays second baseman Ben Williamson has been placed on the 10-day injured list due to a right hamstring strain, effective retroactive to August 6, 2026. Williamson's status will be reassessed after the 10-day period.

top_news.title: **Royals Acquire Jacob Berry in Trade**
top_news.summary: The Kansas City Royals have made a move to bolster their lineup, acquiring first baseman Jacob Berry from the Miami Marlins. Berry joins the Royals after being traded in a deal that brings him to the Midwest.
